spec.title: Requests by handler
spec.description: Excludes `base`, the `/v2/` endpoint a healthcheck polls; `Latency & Storage · Handler latency` still lists it.

spec.title: Errors by status
spec.description: 404 is routine on a pull-through mirror: it is returned whenever the upstream registry does not hold the requested tag or blob.

spec.title: Request latency
spec.description:
Client requests, the `/v2/` healthcheck excluded. Measured to the last byte, so it tracks blob size and upstream speed as much as server health.
- 60 s is the top bucket: a p99 there means slower than 60 s.

spec.title: Handler latency
spec.description:
A handler with a handful of requests can top the p99 on one slow call.
- Measured to the last byte, so it tracks blob size and upstream speed as much as server health.
- 60 s is the top bucket: a p99 there means slower than 60 s.
- Values under 5 ms sit in the first bucket and do not compare.

spec.expr:
histogram_quantile(0.50,
  sum by (handler, le) (rate(registry_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{registry=~"$registry"}[$__range]))
)
and on (handler) (sum by (handler) (increase(registry_http_request_duration_seconds_count{registry=~"$registry"}[$__range])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.99,
  sum by (handler, le) (rate(registry_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{registry=~"$registry"}[$__range]))
)
and on (handler) (sum by (handler) (increase(registry_http_request_duration_seconds_count{registry=~"$registry"}[$__range])) > 0)

spec.title: In-flight requests
spec.description: Peak concurrency within each bar; bursts shorter than the scrape interval are missed.

spec.title: Failures by repository
spec.description:
Registry log lines that carry an error code, one per failed request.
- `manifest unknown`, `name unknown`: answered 404.
- `unknown`: an upstream refusal, the line carrying `denied` or `unauthorized`, answered 500.

spec.expr:
sum by (vars_name, err_code) (count_over_time({syslog_id=~"docker/registry-($registry)", syslog_id!="docker/registry-alloy"}
  | logfmt
  | err_code != ``
[$__range]))

spec.title: Uptime
spec.description: Shortest uptime among the selected registries.

spec.title: Upstream fetches
spec.description:
Objects downloaded on a cache miss, then kept in the cache.
- Tag lookups are not counted, though a pull by tag makes one upstream on every request.

spec.title: Proxy summary
spec.description:
`Up` is the last scrape of the registry's metrics endpoint.
- `Hit ratio`: per object, so a manifest weighs the same as a blob.

spec.title: Storage actions
spec.description:
Calls the registry makes into its storage driver, one level below the HTTP handlers.
- Every action except `Stat`, which a storage health check also calls every 10 s; its count is in `Latency & Storage · Storage action latency`.

spec.title: Storage action latency
spec.description: A p99 under 5 ms sits in the first bucket and does not compare; the mean moves when the disk does.

spec.expr:
histogram_quantile(0.99,
  sum by (action, le) (rate(registry_storage_action_seconds_bucket{registry=~"$registry"}[$__range]))
)
and on (action) (sum by (action) (increase(registry_storage_action_seconds_count{registry=~"$registry"}[$__range])) > 0)

spec.title: Descriptor cache hit ratio
spec.description: The cache is in memory: it starts empty at every restart.

spec.title: Descriptor cache misses
spec.description:
Blob descriptor lookups the cache could not answer; each falls through to a storage `Stat`.
- `errors`: failures of the cache itself.

spec.title: Error ratio
spec.description:
`5xx` responses as a share of client requests, the `/v2/` healthcheck excluded from both sides.
- A failing healthcheck shows in `Overview · Errors by status`.

spec.title: CPU
spec.description: CPU time as a share of one core: 250% is 2.5 cores.

spec.title: Memory
spec.description: Resident memory of each registry process: the Go heap plus stacks, mmap'ed regions and allocator overhead.

spec.title: Goroutines
spec.description: Peak within each bucket. Sustained growth against a flat request rate is a leak.

The latest reading, except:
- `CPU`: averaged over the range.
- `Restarts`: process starts within the range.

spec.title: p99 latency
spec.description:
Client requests, the `/v2/` healthcheck excluded. Measured to the last byte, so it tracks blob size and upstream speed as much as server health.
- 60 s is the top bucket: a value there means slower than 60 s.
Everything the registry logs, unfiltered: its log level and access-log setting decide what lands here.

spec.title: Cache hit ratio
spec.description:
Share of blobs and manifests served from the cache, counted per object: a small manifest hit weighs the same as a large blob.
- A pull by tag still resolves the tag upstream on every request; only the manifest itself comes from the cache.

spec.title: Served to clients
spec.description: Blob and manifest bytes only.

spec.title: Fetched from upstream
spec.description: Bytes downloaded on cache misses; `Served to clients` minus this is what the cache saved.

spec.name: repo
spec.label: Repository
spec.description: A substring of the raw log line, so `golang` also matches `golang-alpine` and any line that mentions it elsewhere. Logs tab only: the metrics carry no repository. Set by clicking a repository, or typed here.
